profile_text.body:
ElevenLabs is an AI voice technology company founded in 2022 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company describes itself as building its own foundational models, beginning with what it calls the first human-like voice model and extending beyond voice. Its platform offers access to more than 5,000 voices across 70 or more languages through APIs and SDKs, and it positions its text-to-speech models as independently rated leaders optimized for consistency, latency, or emotional control across 29 or more languages.

The company's product suite includes ElevenAgents, aimed at customer experience applications, and ElevenCreative, targeted at content creation, alongside its core AI voice generator. ElevenLabs markets its platform to enterprises, creators, and developers.

The site's held facts note ElevenLabs carries a law exposure count of 220 associated with New York, and its tracked product is flagged with a note regarding voice cloning and likeness or consent risk, reflecting broader concerns in the industry around the use of AI-generated voices without explicit authorization. No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are on record for the company at this time.
